title: The Memory Palace
subtitle: A world that continues to grow with me.
description: An explorable digital museum connecting mathematical research, projects, music, images and unfinished ideas. The original academic portfolio and nonlinear glass study remain preserved at /legacy/. This gallery is a new chapter of the same personal site.

title: VOID//ECHO
subtitle: An early exploration of immersive web space.
description: An experimental immersive 3D website exploring atmosphere, narrative and interactive visual systems. Built with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Three.js, React Three Fiber, Framer Motion, GSAP and Lenis. Displayed here as part of my creative history, with its original visual direction preserved in the repository.
coverCaption: ACTUAL PROJECT INTERFACE / LOCAL BROWSER CAPTURE

title: Big Mouth Burger
subtitle: Product storytelling as a visual experiment.
description: A fictional food-brand concept exploring product storytelling, motion, visual hierarchy and consumer-facing interface design through a 3D burger interaction. A concept project rather than a real commercial brand.

title: Giannis / Editorial
subtitle: An athlete's story in rhythm and scale.
description: A fan-made Giannis Antetokounmpo editorial website exploring athlete storytelling, responsive composition and high-impact visual presentation. Unofficial fan work with no affiliation to the athlete or team.

title: Sci-Fi Portfolio
subtitle: Ten studies in interactive interfaces.
description: An original science-fiction-inspired interactive web portfolio containing ten independent project interfaces and their previews. It is shown as an earlier creative experiment, with its separate original art direction available in the public repository.
